warnings: op1 direct read (house 11). A dedicated standards sheet for grab-rail installation (4 details: sink, approach-wall, toilet-front, toilet-side) — matches Thai universal-design/accessibility code dimensions (rail height 0.70-1.30m at seat height range for toilets, per standard accessibility guidelines). This sheet has no house-specific quantities, it's a reference standard reused wherever grab rails appear on A-06/A-07/A-10/A-11.

NORMALIZED_2026-08-02: this house stored section data in per-file ad-hoc arrays (details) instead of the elements[] that houses 01-09 use. Folded into elements[] with element_id/element_type, and mark->element_id, size_m -> width_mm/height_mm, thickness_m -> thickness_mm, rebar/top/bottom strings -> objects. Every original string is kept in a *_printed_as field. NOTE: the array named 'column_sections' actually held BEAM sections - every cut_ref names a B-mark - so those became element_type 'beam', with the cut label kept in section_ref. confidence_score is null because this house never recorded one; it was NOT invented.
